proposed_from.topic: Union-honest rank-and-strength adaptation for a scalar missing-block functional under a public fixed four-block causal-panel mask. Define rank zero separately and exact-rank positive-strength strata. Characterize finite-sample minimax expected length on every stratum under honesty over their union. Decide whether pairwise observed-Gaussian moduli suffice or least-favorable mixtures enlarge the correct functional. Deliver an evaluable characterization and either one data-only q/h-free attaining interval or the sharp unavoidable simultaneous excess. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: a legal 4x4 rank-two signed-permutation mixture has no linear term in chi-square divergence despite positive component KL, and a balanced rank-one analogue suggests an n^(1/4) gap over pairwise modulus. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: simultaneous mixture-test inversion. EARLY KILL TEST: certified solution of the zero-plus-64-orbit interval problem.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The new focal object is the explicit sixty-four-constraint expected-length dual induced by a legal common-target rank-completion orbit. Its proposed strict full-dual versus pairwise-dual inequality shows that componentwise ordered comparisons can omit part of the simultaneous coverage price. The exact Gram calculation also rejects the suggested n^{1/4} extrapolation: a fixed orbit retains exponentially large diagonal cross-moments. The unresolved contribution is coherent data-only inversion over all ranks and strengths, or the exact unavoidable simultaneous excess.

seed_details.one_line: Characterize exact expected length for rank zero versus a legal sixty-four-point rank-two orbit and certify a strict full-dual gap over all pairwise restrictions.
seed_details.anchor_location: Section 7, fuzzy-hypothesis lemma and Step 2 of the strong-nonadaptivity proof, equations defining the mixture chi-square cross-moment.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace sparse-support overlap moments by the full Gram matrix of the twelve observed coordinates of the signed-permutation completion orbit.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for deterministic-mask low-rank scalar confidence intervals and least-favorable mixture expected length found no paper solving this finite orbit.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Cai--Guo because any fuzzy alternative yields an expected-length lower bound.
seed_details.rebuttal: Cai--Guo supplies a lower-bound template, not the exact three-action primal--dual value, purification, or a strict separation from every componentwise dual under a missing-block rank constraint.

seed_details.one_line: Derive the finite-sample expected-length frontier on rank zero and every exact-rank stratum indexed by the anchor singular strength.
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction on hidden weak-factor bias, Theorems on the nuclear-norm error and bias-aware coverage, and the comparison subsection on unavoidable adaptation cost.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace minimax-linear nuclear-norm bias control by the nonlinear completion fiber \(D=GA^{+}F\) and its composite rank-orientation tests.
seed_details.destination_search: The weak-factor, missing-panel, and adaptive-confidence scans found strength-uniform validity and instance-wise intervals, but no finite-sample union-honest expected-length phase diagram.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from weak-factor bias-aware intervals by evaluating their width as the singular value drifts.
seed_details.rebuttal: Those intervals do not minimize stratum expected length under a common union coverage constraint, and their bias bounds do not determine the least-favorable orientation mixture.

seed_details.one_line: Derive the local likelihood experiment and non-Gaussian profile-inversion limit when the smallest anchor singular value is of the same order as Gaussian noise.
seed_details.anchor_location: Introduction and main weak-factor asymptotic theorem, where principal components become inconsistent and centered estimators have explicit nonstandard limits.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the spiked-covariance eigenvector expansion by a finite masked Gaussian expansion of the rational map \(GA^{+}F\) at a rank-changing boundary.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining weak identification, matrix completion, deterministic four-block masks, and profile likelihood found no local limit for this scalar counterfactual functional.
seed_details.red_team: A delta method or a standard weak-instrument ratio limit gives the answer immediately.
seed_details.rebuttal: At rank change the Moore--Penrose map is direction dependent and the nuisance orientations are composite, so neither the regular delta method nor a scalar ratio experiment supplies the joint limit.

proposed_from.literature_map: The selected kernel sits at the intersection of four threads. First, CaiLow2004AdaptiveCI formulates honest expected length through between-class and ordered moduli in the Introduction, Definition 2, and Theorems 1--3; Section 5 treats nonconvex unions but retains pairwise modulus geometry. Second, CaiGuo2017HDLinearCI develops a fuzzy-hypothesis expected-length lemma and computes null-mixture chi-square affinity in Step 2 of the strong-nonadaptivity proof; CarpentierKloppLofflerNickl2018 makes composite low-rank testing the bridge to honest confidence sets in Theorems 2.1--2.2 and its Theorem 5.2 proof. Third, EvansHansenStark2005 proves expected-measure Bayes--minimax duality in Theorem 1 and Section 4.1, providing the adjacent decision-theory architecture for an exact rather than lower-bound-only orbit calculation. Fourth, YanWainwright2024MissingPanel gives an entrywise Gaussian approximation, plug-in confidence interval, and genie-aided Cram\'er--Rao benchmark under staggered missingness; ArmstrongWeidnerZeleneev2026 and Onatski2012WeakFactors explain why factor strength changes inferential behavior; ChoiKwonLiao2026UnknownRank corrects over-rank ridge bias but retains a working-rank upper bound. The exact target--method search found no paper combining a deterministic four-block null space, scalar missing-block expected length, exact-rank strength strata, and a least-favorable orientation-mixture dual. NicklVandeGeer2013 supplies the nearby \(n^{-1/4}\) composite-testing boundary, but its growing-dimensional sparse geometry does not survive the fixed-orbit diagonal cross-moment check.

banked_reason: The exact continuum minimax frontier and sharp simultaneous excess remain unproved; the sound finite-grid duality and constant-factor continuum interval achieve subfield rather than the field floor.
